controls.effect: a failed control is PROTOCOL_FAILURE (no certificate); controls never alter a target gate

execution_order: Q1 locally and on the host
Q2+Q3 runs on vultr-02 at the freeze commit
science rung(s) per ladder at the qualification commit
adjudicate_point build; record commits; commit+push adjudication

gates.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise (interval contains 0 or touches it from below)
gates.precedence: CERTIFIED, then REFUTED, then INCONCLUSIVE; [0,0] is REFUTED
gates.premise: all targets CERTIFIED -> SATISFIED; any target REFUTED -> REFUTED; else OPEN. ALL_CUSUM_M_GAMMATILDE_GT_1 = CERTIFIED/REFUTED/OPEN accordingly

lineage.reuse_audit: 323e2b8f (p5y_gammatilde_sign_audit: M2 CERTIFIED by reuse, M3/M5 NOT_CERTIFIED, premise OPEN)

m_values.why_evaluated_includes_1_2: one kernel evaluation produces F_0..F_4, D_0..D_4 and every W needed by m=5; m=1 and m=2 are exact re-assemblies of those same objects and are used only as consistency controls

non_claims: no statement beyond the sign of R'(0) for CUSUM m = 3, 5

numerical_backend.certifier: order2.Order2Certifier (parent of production Aux3Certifier) prepare + all_residuals; aux_propagate.cell_dag(delta_mid); propagate.enclosures; assembly.assemble orders 0,1

point_cell.construction: code/point_core.py point_cell: left = right = e0 = e, rho = 0; C_upper inherited from frozen CUSUM cell 0 ([0, 2 e0], C_evaluation = 0 exactly)

precision_ladder.note: Taylor order 120, collocation degree 12 and quadrature 400 are frozen at every rung; only Arb working precision changes
precision_ladder.rule: run 256 first; escalate to the next rung only if some target m is INCONCLUSIVE at the last rung; stop at the first rung where every target is decisive or the ladder is exhausted. Per target, the first decisive rung decides; contradictory decisive statuses = PROTOCOL_FAILURE.

qualification_plan.Q1: python3 -B qualification/test_point_core.py passes (manufactured positive/negative/zero/near-zero derivatives, malformed interval, wrong m, wrong manifest, malformed identity, protocol/wrapper tamper, point geometry, precision ladder, controls, premise)
qualification_plan.Q2: point_eval replay-cell0 reproduces the committed K1 cell-0 record R_interval and D_interval EXACTLY for m=1,2,3,5
qualification_plan.Q3: point_eval point-e0 (degenerate cell {e0}) gives R and D enclosures contained in the record's for every m
qualification_plan.Q4: both runs bound to this protocol hash, initial+final gates, identity == producer_identity, SciPy guard clean
qualification_plan.verdict: code/qualify_point.py; PASS requires Q1-Q5; science refuses without a PASS bound to this protocol hash

retry_policy: a run that terminates WITHOUT writing an output file (crash, gate refusal, timeout) may be re-run once at the same rung with identical inputs after the cause is recorded; an output file, once written, is final and is never re-run or overwritten (point_eval refuses to overwrite).
runtime_contract: manifest v3 runtime contract (hash bc75c9ea), verified live by manifest_v3.verify() and runtime_identity5.require() at the initial and final gates
scientific_hash: sha256(canonical(scientific)) where scientific = {cell, precision_bits, method, m:{R_interval, D_interval}}; runtime (cpu, wall, rss, start epoch) and gate reports are outside it

scientific_target.SCIENTIFIC_TARGET: sign of R_m'(0), equivalently GammaTilde_m > 1 (P1-T1 at rho=1: R_m'(0) = 1 - GammaTilde_m)
scientific_target.object: certified outward exact-rational enclosure of R_m'(e) at e = 0 exactly, frozen K1 CUSUM raw-variable R_m (k=1/2, h=5, reset, convention A, terminal increment included, random denominator, c_(m,t)=1/t-1/m, no leading +e)

separation: sole purpose: sign of R_m'(0) for CUSUM. NOT a K5 order-3 probe; no signed-R''' object, no cells 148/305/309, no order-3 campaign, no K1 record or CUSUM composite modified, no AWS/PS1, no origin/main.
serialization: canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII, trailing newline); every interval endpoint is an exact rational string from intervals.record (outward); no float enters a gate
